title: A survey of threats against voice authentication and anti-spoofing systems
title_zh: 语音身份验证与反欺骗系统威胁调查
abstract: Abstract Voice authentication has evolved from traditional systems based on hand-engineered acoustic features to deep learning models that learn speaker representations directly from audio. This progress has improved accuracy, but it has also opened new attack surfaces. Prior surveys treat these threats in isolation; we instead provide a unified analysis of the four primary attack vectors against voice authentication: data poisoning, adversarial perturbations, audio deepfakes, and adversarial spoofing. We organize them along three axes: what the attacker knows, how the attack is delivered, and how broadly it generalizes across speakers and inputs. Comparing these vectors reveals a clear gap in threat maturity. Adversarial perturbations are effective when the attacker has full model access, but often fail once the audio is played over the air. Deepfakes, by contrast, scale easily, succeed without model access, and routinely fool both machines and human listeners. Existing Anti-Spoofing Countermeasures (CMs) remain largely reactive and can themselves be bypassed by adaptive attacks. We close by mapping open challenges and arguing for standardized threat models and defenses that act proactively, in real time.
abstract_zh: 摘要 语音身份验证已从基于手工设计声学特征的传统系统发展为直接从音频中学习说话人表示的深度学习模型。这一进展提升了准确性，但也打开了新的攻击面。以往的综述将这些威胁孤立讨论；本文则提供了对语音身份验证四大主要攻击向量的统一分析：数据投毒、对抗扰动、音频深度伪造和对抗性欺骗。我们从攻击者所知、攻击方式以及跨说话人和输入的泛化范围三条轴线对其进行组织。比较这些向量揭示了威胁成熟度的明显差距。对抗扰动在攻击者拥有完整模型访问时有效，但在音频通过空中播放后往往失效。相反，深度伪造易于扩展，且无需模型访问即可成功，并且经常欺骗机器和人类听众。现有的反欺骗对策（CMs）大多是被动的，且可被自适应攻击绕过。我们以映射未解决挑战并主张采用标准化威胁模型和主动、实时防御来结束本文。
